summary: STMicroelectronics filed a Form 6-K reporting its Q1 2026 financial results. Net revenues were $3.10B, gross margin 33.8%, operating income $70M, net income $37M ($0.04 EPS). The filing includes non-GAAP adjustments for the acquisition of NXP's MEMS sensor business and provides Q2 guidance. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign is disclosed; it is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer.
